output.title: Contemporary 3-Bedroom Duplex with Panoramic City Views in Cloche d'Or
output.description:
This newly built duplex apartment offers 180 m² of thoughtfully designed living space within Luxembourg's Cloche d'Or district. The voluminous living area features a double-height ceiling and expansive panoramic windows that provide abundant natural light and views over a nearby park. Engineered oak flooring throughout enhances the modern aesthetic while the internal staircase elegantly connects the two levels.

The open-plan kitchen is fitted with Siemens appliances and topped with a durable quartz work surface. Soft-close cabinets provide storage solutions while maintaining a sleek, uncluttered appearance. This kitchen integrates seamlessly with the dining and living areas, creating a sociable and functional environment.

Accommodation includes three bedrooms and two bathrooms. The upper-floor master bedroom benefits from fitted wardrobes and direct access to a private terrace. This wraparound terrace features wood decking and affords views over the adjacent shopping center, oriented to receive evening sun exposure.

Additional amenities comprise elevator access to the unit, private parking, and a separate cellar for storage. Located in Cloche d'Or, the property is situated within Luxembourg’s contemporary business district, which features a large shopping center and public parks, offering urban convenience in a modern setting.

highlights.text: 180 m² duplex with double-height living room
Three bedrooms, including master with terrace access
Wraparound upper-level terrace with city views
Located in Luxembourg's modern Cloche d'Or district
